name: Cafe & Restaurant Wanninger
kurzbeschreibung: Café & Restaurant Wanninger in Oberammergau Welcome to Café & Restaurant Wanninger in the heart of Oberammergau, where tradition meets modern charm.
beschreibung: The Cafe & Restaurant Wanninger in Oberammergau in the Kufstein region is the perfect destination for a restful break and satisfying meal. In this pleasantly appointed venue, guests enjoy specialty coffees, homemade pastries, and hearty regional dishes. Attentive service and traditional decor create a warm environment for travelers exploring the surrounding alpine scenery.
